title: Compute brief — 25 September 2026
description: DigitalOcean MI350X spot ticks $3.00→$2.46 and MI355X spot $4.50→$2.97; B300 spot holds $8.00. Applied Digital names Brookwood, AL for Delta Forge 2 (210 MW leased). CleanSpark $2.276B notes still priced-not-closed on stated close morning. Lambda H100 $3.99 / B200 $6.69 / GH200 $2.29 hold.
og_kicker: DO MI350X tick; Applied Digital Brookwood; CleanSpark open
lede: The public rental tape moved again on DigitalOcean while the conversion desk unlocked Alabama geography for an already-leased AI Factory campus. Same-venue re-read 25 Sep: DigitalOcean MI350X spot printed $2.46 (was $3.00 on 23–24 Sep) and MI355X spot $2.97 (was $4.50); B300 spot held $8.00. Lambda on-demand anchors stayed sticky at H100 $3.99 / B200 $6.69 / GH200 $2.29 (67 confirms, 2 ticks, 0 NEW across six venues). On 24 Sep Applied Digital confirmed Delta Forge 2 will sit in Brookwood, Tuscaloosa County, Alabama — the previously disclosed 210 MW critical-IT 15-year take-or-pay lease with an unnamed U.S. investment-grade hyperscaler (~$5.2B base-term revenue per the 8 Jun IR), with TCEDA approving roughly $314.5M in tax abatements plus $270M community-benefit payments; construction is scheduled about 1 Oct 2026. CleanSpark’s $2.276B notes remain priced-not-closed on the morning of the stated 25 Sep close (EFTS still only the 18 Sep pricing 8-K). TCEQ verbally confirmed an air/water authorization pause tied to Abbott’s 21 Sep letter; scope outside the ERCOT RFI set is still undefined. One new Wire id.
